notPorted.reason: TupleQuery.setBinding("v", 1) and setBinding("g", :g1): RDF4J pre-binds ?v throughout the query, so FILTER(?v = 1) inside GRAPH sees it. A VALUES block (top level or trailing) is joined bottom-up and does not reach that FILTER (SPARQL 1.1 Query 18.2.4, 18.6), so no SPARQL text is equivalent.

The oracle is relative: DESCRIBE <_:bnode1> must equal the same implementation's DESCRIBE ?s WHERE { VALUES ?s { <_:bnode1> } }, a policy (not a fixed graph); there is no fixed expected graph to port.
Needs a controlled document resolver for LOAD <https://example.invalid/input.ttl> (the Java test serves a local temporary file); the core API has no LOAD source resolver.

Needs a mocked federated SERVICE (RDF4J MockFederatedService registered for https://example.invalid/service) that answers or rejects with configured blank-node identity behaviour; not observable through the core API.
